task.title: e2e serial runs outlive the 15-minute auth cookies
task.description: Discovered during WB-01M0DSYZDJ verification: both auth cookies carry Max-Age=900 and the Playwright fixture logs in once per run, so any chromium run longer than ~15 minutes starts failing with 401s partway through (a full serial pass takes ~20m; one run showed 84 of 105 late failures were pure 401s). Workaround used: shard the suite (4 shards, one login per shard). Real fixes to evaluate: re-login per spec file or on 401, refresh the cookie mid-run, or a longer dev-only cookie lifetime. This poisons every future task's full-suite verification and inflates the pre-existing-failure baseline; related to the fixture-pool debt WB-01KZMVA2Y1.
